briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 push capability boundaries as global compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid iteration with multimodal and reasoning advances while regulatory scrutiny grows in US, EU and China. Investment remains robust with major infra deals closing this quarter.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with enhanced agentic capabilities while xAI deployed Grok-4 on expanded Memphis cluster. DeepSeek-V3.5 and Meta Llama-4-405B updates also landed this week.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST and EU AI Office released new red-teaming guidelines.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC and Samsung announced new 2nm AI chip capacity allocations. Google and Microsoft both broke ground on additional 1GW+ data center sites in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first publicly acknowledged 10^27 FLOP training run occur before 2028?
